title: CAN Receive
text: Enhanced Controller Area Network receive mailbox, 4 outputs, {Message identifier mask} sets identifier mask; {Module} sets the cAN module the block, {Mailbox number(0–31)} sets the s value of mailbox number register, {Message identifier} sets the s value of message identifier register, {Message type} sets the message identifier type Standard, {Enable acceptance filter} enables to use ID filtering, {Sample time} sets the frequency at which mailbox is polled for new, {Data type} sets the output message data, {Initial output} sets the s output before receiving data, {Action when message not received} sets the action when no new CAN message received Output last message, {Output message ID} sets the output message identifier status, {Output message length}, {Post interrupt when message is received} sets the posts asynchronous interrupt when message and {Interrupt line}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Module
params.values: CAN module the block configures CAN_A (default) | CAN_B

params.name: Mailbox number(0–31)
params.values: Sets value of mailbox number register (MBNR) 0 (default) | integer in the range [0 31]

params.name: Message identifier
params.values: Sets value of message identifier register (MID) bin2dec(’111000111’) (default) | numeric identifier of length 11 or 29 bits

params.name: Message type
params.values: Message identifier type Standard (11-bit identifier) (default) | Extended (29-bit identifier)

params.name: Enable acceptance filter
params.values: Enable to use ID filtering off (default) | on

params.name: Message identifier mask
params.values: identifier mask 0 (default) | 1 | numeric identifier of length 11 or 29 bits

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which mailbox is polled for new message 1 (default) | -1 | scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output message data type uint16 (default) | uint8 | uint32 | CAN_MESSAGE_TYPE

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Sets output before receiving data 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Action when message not received
params.values: Action when no new CAN message received Output last message received (default) | Reset all fields to zero

params.name: Output message ID
params.values: Output message identifier status off (default) | on

params.name: Output message length
params.values: Output message length in bytes off (default) | on

params.name: Post interrupt when message is received
params.values: Posts asynchronous interrupt when message is received off (default) | on
